---
name: Focused improvement
about: Propose a concrete workflow improvement and its acceptance criteria
---

## Workflow and problem

What are you trying to accomplish? Which current command or screen is involved?

## Proposed behavior

Describe a concrete input and expected outcome.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Runnable example with an independently checkable result
- [ ] Failure or boundary case identified
- [ ] Documentation and verification scope identified

## Existing alternatives and boundaries

Link a relevant guide or roadmap item. Note effects on timing, persistence, compatibility or exported evidence.
